text:
alex: Morning async — quick check-in. What I did: investigated SLO blips overnight, noticed a bump in 5xxs (0.6% vs target <0.5%) and tail latency. Found correlated KV cache evictions on a subset of dedicated nodes. Blockers: can't repro locally, looks infra-specific. Today: run a canary with adjusted eviction policy, collect traces, and coordinate alert tuning. :wave:

maria: Thanks — I opened RED-321 (tracking) and linked the initial graph. Also put a short perf dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/RED-321 :eyes:

oncall-bot: Incident auto-ticket created: INC-2024-0789 for RED-321. Pager assigned to oncall rotation.

sam: I have a small change that adjusts eviction thresholds and KV cap handling. Need CR from @tanya before canary. Patch: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/pull/1423

tanya: I can review in ~2 hours. Quick thought: paging is coming from the 95th latency alert — propose we change rule to 99th and add a 5m aggregation to cut noise while we investigate.

ben: FYI I rolled a batching tweak last night (smaller micro-batches for short sequences). Telemetry looks marginally better for p50/p90, but p99 is where we see the eviction tail. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/runtime/pull/987 :thumbsup:

maria: Blocker for me — reproducer only on dedicated infra. Can someone paste the last 200 lines from runtime journal on the failing node? e.g. `sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 200`

alex: I'll run that on the canary node now and paste relevant excerpt. One sec.

alex: Log excerpt below (filtering noise):
```
Mar 03 03:11:58 node-7 redwood-runtime[2412]: kv_cache: size=1208MB limit=1024MB evicting entries
Mar 03 03:12:01 node-7 redwood-runtime[2412]: evict: policy=LRU reclaimed=210MB latency_ms=123.6
Mar 03 03:12:02 node-7 redwood-runtime[2412]: request: id=abc123 seq_len=2048 tokens=120 status=200 time_ms=1804
Mar 03 03:12:02 node-7 redwood-runtime[2412]: oom_guard: triggered=true freed=0
```

alex: Looks like misconfigured KV limit on those nodes + oom_guard triggering leads to long blocking evictions. I think raising limit or more aggressive incremental eviction will remove the p99 tail.

tanya: I'll prepare a canary config with `kv_cache.limit_mb: 1536` and `evict.incremental: true`. Will push to canary once @deploy-bot schedules it.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled — redwood-runtime v2.14.3 -> canary on nodes (node-7,node-8,node-9). Start at 2045679500. Estimated 6m rollout.

sam: I'll hold off on merging the eviction PR until canary is green. Also I'm lowering severity of `inference_request_high_95` to warning for the window of the rollout to avoid noisy pages.

alex: Great. After canary finishes I'll collect traces and SLO deltas and report back in this thread. Thanks all for the quick sync. :thumbsup:
